Toucannon

Normal Flying

Alola · Generation 7

Toucannon is a Normal/Flying-type Cannon Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 26 kg. It evolves from Trumbeak. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 485.
